description:
## Objective

Restore Signal benchmark correctness and the manual Signal benchmark runner.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U4`
Covers: `R1, R2, R7; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.1 (U1) — Establish the quality source manifest and runners must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.7 (U7) — Port Action and Flow benchmark smoke checks must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_signal/test/bench/**` and `../refs/jido_signal/bench/**` at the Signal baseline. Add `test/bench/signal/**` and `bench/signal/**`. Exclude `../refs/jido_signal/bench/results/**`. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port the three correctness tests and benchmark support code.
2. Write new reports only under ignored `tmp/bench/signal/`.
3. Keep result validation and environment metadata.
4. Remove timing and memory pass thresholds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Smoke tests validate results and cleanup before measurement.
- [ ] No historical result file is copied.
- [ ] The manual runner needs no network or service.

## Verification

- `mix test.bench test/bench/signal` and `mix run bench/signal/run.exs --profile smoke` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text:
Completion report:
- Changed files: bench/signal/run.exs; bench/signal/support/*.exs; test/bench/signal/*.exs; test/quality/source_manifest.yml.
- Manifest: marked test/bench and bench ported; recorded bench/results and bench/compare.exs as excluded historical assets.
- Verification: mix test.bench test/bench/signal (15 passed, seed 0); mix run bench/signal/run.exs --profile smoke (150 cases, valid JSON and Markdown reports, all owned_remaining values are 0); mix format --check-formatted; mix reach.check --arch --smells (architecture OK, existing smell inventory only); mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs (6 passed); git diff --check.
- Deferred assets: none.
- Deviations: adapted old package owners to current public Jido owners; removed timing and memory pass thresholds as required by the plan; adapted Trace.child result validation for current parent_span_id behavior.
- Remaining blockers: none.
- Scope: no lib changes and no refs changes.
- Commit: c5f30e9.
